lines.a1: You know exactly what you want to say.
lines.a2: Then the fillers creep in. You rush. You lose the camera. And nobody tells you, until it's over.
lines.a3: Meet Pitch Mirror. An AI speaking coach that listens while you talk.
lines.a4: Rehearse a pitch, or an interview. Your words appear live, and the coach steps in only when it measures a problem.
lines.a5: Then, take it into the real call. A small notch sits above Zoom, Google Meet, or Teams, with silent nudges only you can see.
lines.a6: When you finish, you get a scored review, every question with a stronger answer, and a follow-up email, ready to send.
lines.a7: Pitch Mirror. Speak like you rehearsed.
lines.b1: This is Pitch Mirror. A speaking coach that's with you while you talk, not after.
lines.b2: Most feedback arrives too late. Pitch Mirror listens live, measures how you speak, and tells you one thing to fix, right when it matters.
lines.b3: Start in the practice app. Pick your coach, what you're preparing for, and the one thing you want to improve.
lines.b4: As you speak, your words appear on the left. Coaching moments appear on the right: what was measured, and how to fix it.
lines.b5: For real calls, there's Meeting Mode. Add a short brief, and the points you must cover. Then share the meeting tab, so the coach hears both sides.
lines.b6: A small notch sits at the top of your screen. When the client asks a question, it drops an answer outline. It ticks off your points, and flags fillers, and only you can see it.
lines.b7: When the call ends, everything is waiting. A recap, with decisions and action items, and a follow-up email you can copy in one click.
lines.b8: Every question you were asked gets a rating, and a stronger sample answer. And the full transcript is yours to download.
lines.b9: Pitch Mirror. Speak like you rehearsed.
